name: Stick of Blackpool Rock
desc: Pink outside, white inside, and BLACKPOOL written all the way through, built letter by letter by hand. Restores 50 HP and the odd filling.

name: Chippy Tea
desc: Fish, chips and mushy peas in paper, salt and vinegar on, a buttered barm on the side. Restores 100 HP. Eaten on the prom, it restores the soul as well.

name: Potted Shrimps
desc: Little brown shrimps from the Lancashire coast, cooked and sealed in spiced butter, a speciality for over two hundred years. Restores 15 PP to every move.

name: Kiss-Me-Quick Hat
desc: A paper hat from a seafront kiosk with a cheeky slogan on the brim. Somehow it never blows off on the prom, whatever the Irish Sea throws at it.
msg: {name}'s Kiss-Me-Quick Hat kept the wind off!

name: Golden Bulb
desc: A gilded bulb from the Blackpool Illuminations, given to the stand-in who threw the switch. Doreen says it still glows a bit, if you believe in it.
